about: Brokkr's claims register (decided by H, 3 October 2026; started 4 October 2026 with the figures). Every public claim lists its scope, whether it was pre-registered or exploratory, the prior work it is consistent with (verified references only), the command that produces it and the command that checks it. Numbers are never typed here: they live in the generated figures and docs/figures/figures.json, which the check command verifies against the records. No claim of being first.

claims.claim: Under darkness (Brokkr) s5, shrinking costs some models much more than it does on clean images, while others lose about as much as on clean images; H21's prediction that at least half of the models would show a large extra gap failed.

scope.models: every usable INT8 build of the Stage 4 (task 4.1) models, percentile 99.99 recipe; MobileNetV3-Small left out (its INT8 build failed)
scope.data: ImageNet-1k validation, test split; one laptop CPU (ONNX Runtime)

claims.status: pre-registered: H21 in docs/hypotheses_stage4.md (verdict unchanged); the dashed large-cost line is the label rule, adopted after these results existed
prior_work: Xiao et al., 2023, Benchmarking the Robustness of Quantized Models, arXiv:2304.03968
Yaghoubi Araghi et al., 2026, Recti-Q, arXiv:2607.18540

claims.claim: Which models lose much more to shrinking varies with the damage condition; large shrinking costs cluster under darkness, fog and low contrast.

scope.models: every usable INT8 build in published/labels (the Stage 4 models)
scope.conditions: the twelve damaged conditions on the labels (Brokkr's own and ImageNet-C, named separately)
scope.data: ImageNet-1k validation, test split; one laptop CPU (ONNX Runtime)
scope.intervals: 95% paired bootstrap (in each cell's hover note)

prior_work: Xiao et al., 2023, Benchmarking the Robustness of Quantized Models, arXiv:2304.03968
Hendrycks and Dietterich, 2019, Benchmarking Neural Network Robustness to Common Corruptions and Perturbations, arXiv:1903.12261

claims.claim: For MobileNetV3-Large, prediction sets calibrated on clean images keep their coverage target on clean images but fall below it under several kinds of damage, while their average size changes little.

scope.conditions: clean and the twelve damaged conditions on its label
scope.data: ImageNet-1k validation, test split; prediction sets calibrated on the clean conformal-calibration split

claims.status: measured and reported (Stage 4 records); not a pre-registered verdict
prior_work: Kasa and Taylor, 2023, Empirically Validating Conformal Prediction on Modern Vision Architectures Under Distribution Shift and Long-tailed Data, arXiv:2307.01088

claims.claim: For MobileNetV3-Large, the default INT8 recipe lost much more clean accuracy than the percentile recipe chosen in Stage 3.

scope.models: MobileNetV3-Large: FP32, default INT8 (min-max calibration), INT8 (percentile 99.99)
scope.data: ImageNet-1k validation, test split; one laptop CPU (ONNX Runtime)
scope.intervals: 95% bootstrap, each build on its own (not paired)

claims.status: Stage 1 and Stage 3 records; the percentile recipe was chosen on the tuning split and judged on the test split (H10, docs/hypotheses_stage3.md)

claims.claim: On this laptop CPU, INT8 does not always take less time than FP32; for some models it takes more.

scope.models: every usable INT8 build and its FP32 reference in published/labels
scope.conditions: random input, batch 1, 1 and 4 threads pinned to the laptop's performance cores
scope.data: laptop latency records (results/latency), median across sessions
scope.intervals: none; spread across sessions is shown as the unstable mark

claims.status: measured by the latency method fixed in dated notes before measuring; a relative comparison on one laptop CPU only

claims.where: website landing page: the two sentences under "What we found" (beside the hero figure, claim fig-hero)
claims.claim: Under darkness (Brokkr) s5, few shrunk models lost much more to shrinking than on clean images, fewer than H21 predicted (verdict FAIL); MobileNetV3-Large's shrunk build is the example: a small shrinking cost on clean images and a much larger one under that damage.

scope.models: every usable INT8 build of the Stage 4 (task 4.1) models judged for H21; the example is MobileNetV3-Large (percentile 99.99)
scope.data: ImageNet-1k validation, test split; one laptop CPU (ONNX Runtime)
scope.intervals: 95% paired bootstrap (on the meter and the model page)
